notes: Add independent fixed-seed switches for HED scheduling and native roamer layout. Disabled inputs retain their saved integers while runtime follows the mission seed. Keep scheduling, roamer layout and HCM condition-event randomness separately owned and explain their exact scope in the interface. Advance preset format to four to preserve HCM condition-event seed settings as well as both HED seeds. Older presets remain readable and keep the current HCM seed when absent. Preserve current-mission snapshots and the independent native global random generator. Fixed seeds reproduce controlled choices, not the complete live battle.
